eligibility.plain_english: Days past due at the cut-off date must be 30 or fewer.
eligibility.clause_text: No scheduled payment on the Receivable is more than 30 days past due.

eligibility.plain_english: The loan must not be charged off and the vehicle must not have been repossessed.
eligibility.clause_text: The Receivable has not been charged off and the related Financed Vehicle has not been repossessed.

eligibility.plain_english: Original term must be 84 months or less.
eligibility.clause_text: The original term of the Receivable is 84 months or less.

eligibility.plain_english: FICO score at origination must be 540 or higher.
eligibility.clause_text: The Obligor's FICO score at origination is 540 or higher.

eligibility.plain_english: Outstanding Balance must not exceed US$75,000. Mapped to current_balance (unpaid principal at the cut-off date).
eligibility.clause_text: The Outstanding Balance of the Receivable does not exceed US$75,000.

eligibility.plain_english: Obligor's billing address must be in one of the 50 US states or DC. The tape gives obligor_state, not the billing address itself.
eligibility.clause_text: The Obligor's billing address is in one of the fifty states of the United States or the District of Columbia.

eligibility.plain_english: Obligor's billing address must not be in a Restricted Jurisdiction. The schedules provided do not list which jurisdictions are Restricted Jurisdictions.
eligibility.clause_text: The Obligor's billing address is not in a Restricted Jurisdiction.

eligibility.plain_english: The loan may have been modified at most once since origination.
eligibility.clause_text: The terms of the Receivable have been modified no more than once since origination.

eligibility.plain_english: APR must be between 6.00% and 29.99% inclusive. Limits are expressed in percent; confirm the tape's APR units.
eligibility.clause_text: The annual percentage rate of the Receivable is not less than 6.00% and not more than 29.99%.

eligibility.plain_english: Vehicle model year must be no more than ten years before the year of origination.
eligibility.clause_text: The model year of the Financed Vehicle is no more than ten years before the year of origination of the Receivable.

eligibility.plain_english: The obligor must have made at least one scheduled payment.
eligibility.clause_text: The Obligor has made at least one scheduled payment on the Receivable.

eligibility.plain_english: The VIN must not appear on any other loan in the pool.
eligibility.clause_text: The Financed Vehicle is identified by a Vehicle Identification Number that appears on no other Receivable in the Pool.

concentration.plain_english: Eligible receivables with obligors billed in any one state may not exceed 20% of the Eligible Pool Balance. The excess is an excess concentration amount.
concentration.clause_text: Obligors with a billing address in any one state

concentration.plain_english: Eligible receivables from any one Dealer may not exceed 5% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name count as one Dealer. The tape has dealer_name only, so common-ownership groupings cannot be identified from the tape alone.
concentration.clause_text: Receivables originated by any one Dealer, treating Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name as one Dealer

concentration.plain_english: Eligible receivables with an original term of more than 72 months may not exceed 25% of the Eligible Pool Balance.
concentration.clause_text: Receivables with an original term of more than 72 months

concentration.plain_english: Eligible receivables secured by used vehicles may not exceed 70% of the Eligible Pool Balance.
concentration.clause_text: Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles

concentration.plain_english: Added by Amendment No. 1 with effect from 1 March 2026. Eligible receivables with an origination FICO below 600 may not exceed 35% of the Eligible Pool Balance. It applies to Borrowing Base Certificates for Collection Periods ending on or after 1 March 2026. The amendment is also subject to the conditions to effectiveness in its Section 3.
concentration.clause_text: 5. Receivables with an Obligor FICO score at origination below 600: 35%
